title: More war and chaos in Mall World
content: So last night I was enjoying Mall World in my sleep, not uncommon, and I was at one of the many bars in town. I remember there was like a townhouse or something attached to it. Anyway, during the party and commotion etc, I begin hearing this machine gun sound. I thought someone was shooting at us until I saw it. It was the Black Night Satellite. It was coming down through the clouds and through the streets and I think it was killing people. The last thing I remember before waking up is seeing a man in military utilities with a control pad and joystick, controlling the Black Night Satellite. Any similar experiences?
